name: Vector
maturity: Fifth public release; backups restore on rer 0.2.77 into native and Platform-migrated installations. Roles, most provider integrations, Managed relay delivery, real Linear/Jira exports and broader capacity remain incomplete or unproven; see CONTRACT.md and CHANGELOG.md.

spine.record: issue or task in a container

description: Track issues, plan projects, and keep software delivery moving.
nonGoals: Roles, per-team visibility, and granular permissions
External customer accounts, portals, forms, or public roadmaps
Source-specific Sentry, Slack, GitLab, Jira, or email integrations in core
AI triage, deduplication, ranking, or project-health inference
Initiatives, roadmaps, Gantt charts, critical-path planning, time tracking
Notification email beyond assignments and direct mentions; chat or push notification channels

externals.why: BASE-ACCESS-001 requires authentication and invitation mail; NOTIFY-006 additionally permits minimal assignment and direct-mention email through the same declared transactional provider.
SLACK-003: an Admin explicitly binds selected issue events to an active, unshared Slack channel containing the bot; credentials are entered in Settings.

SLACK-004: a member looks up and confirms their own Slack account by their sign-in email, then chooses Slack direct messages for assignments and mentions; signed Assign to me and Change status requests return to Vector.
data: workflow status names and status change

externals.why: SLACK-003: an Admin explicitly binds selected issue events to a sealed discord.com or discordapp.com webhook URL.
ERROR-001: an Owner or Admin explicitly connects a Sentry internal integration, reads release metadata for its signed issue events and can resolve a linked Sentry issue after native completion.
ERROR-001: an Owner or Admin explicitly registers a Datadog US1 webhook with pasted API and application keys; registration keys are discarded after the request.
DOCS-001: a reader explicitly loads a public Loom named video link; no account connection or provider credential.
DOCS-001: a reader explicitly loads a public YouTube named video link; no account connection or provider credential.
REPORT-005: an Owner or Admin explicitly consents to hourly incremental exports to their AWS S3 or Cloudflare R2 bucket. Credentials remain in the excluded installation vault.
REPORT-005: an Owner or Admin explicitly reserves a sheet for an hourly saved-list-view sync and supplies their Google refresh grant. Only current visible list properties leave the installation.
data: OAuth client and refresh grant at Google token refresh

env.name: APP_ORIGIN
env.why: Canonical HTTPS origin used in redirects and magic links.

env.name: MAIL_MODE
env.why: production for the configured Base mail provider; local-outbox is restricted to explicit loopback development.

env.name: FIRST_OWNER_EMAIL
env.why: Configured installation owner; never inferred from a request. Required with the other first-run fields when initializing an empty installation.

env.name: FIRST_OWNER_NAME
env.why: Display name of the explicitly configured first operator.

env.name: WORKSPACE_NAME
env.why: Name for the empty workspace at first run.

env.name: WORKSPACE_TIMEZONE
env.why: Named IANA timezone for initial calendar rules.

env.name: DEFAULT_TEAM_NAME
env.why: Name of the first team, created with seven workflow categories.

env.name: DEFAULT_TEAM_PREFIX
env.why: Two to ten uppercase letters for the first team issue identifiers.

env.name: SESSION_SECRET
env.why: At least 32 characters for Base domain-separated session/link credential hashing. Required for the remote installation.

env.name: MAIL_PROVIDER
env.why: Explicit Base mail provider: rer for Managed, sendgrid or resend for direct provider delivery.

env.name: MAIL_API_KEY
env.why: Provider or RER relay credential supplied only as a Worker secret; required by the selected mail provider.

env.name: MAIL_FROM
env.why: Verified sender address for Base sign-in and invitation mail. Required for the remote installation.

env.name: MAIL_RELAY_URL
env.why: HTTPS RER mail relay endpoint; assigned by Managed Configure and required with MAIL_PROVIDER=rer.

env.name: NOTIFICATION_EMAIL_ENABLED
env.why: Set false to disable assignment and direct-mention email. Defaults enabled only with configured mail capability; each operator can independently opt out.

accessibility.status: target; automated level AA, not yet verified on the prototype

operatingCost.assumptions: Up to 20 active operators, 100000 issues, 5 GB attachments, and moderate queue traffic on Cloudflare; transactional email is billed separately by the selected provider.
